chapters.title: Constitution and polity, year by year
chapters.intro: From the Regulating Act of 1773 to the latest amendments: every constitutional act, commission, court case and institution on the timeline, in order. It repeats the polity slides from the history chapters.

fragments.title: The early Republic

fragments.title: Rights, reforms and recent changes
fragments.intro: 44th Amendment, landmark cases, Panchayati Raj, RTI, GST and later amendments.
